# `code.diff.get`

Diff two revisions

Unified patches with rename detection. Ranges join two revisions with ... Only the daemon default context and rename settings are served.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/diff/{range}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie code diff get`
- MCP: `code_diff_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely
